content: Add the reference image to the scene (Image 1). Start with the default cube and scale it: [k]S,X,3.5[/k], [k]S,Y,4.5[/k], [k]S,Z,0.5[/k] (Image 2). [k]Ctrl-R[/k] to add two Loop Cuts in the x-axis and [k]S,Y[/k] to bring them closer together (Image 3). Add two more Loop Cuts inside the new section and [k]S,Y[/k] to move the edge loops further apart (Image 4). Select the inner face on the side and [k]G,X[/k] to push it inwards to make room for the pier (Image 5). Select all edges around the sides and [k]Ctrl-B[/k] to bevel them with seven segments and a width of 1M (Image 6). If the bevel doesn't look correct, [k]Tab[/k] into Object Mode and [k]Ctrl-A,S[/k] to apply the scale. Select the edges by the pier cutout and [k]Ctrl-B,C[/k] to bevel those edges but clamp them so the bevels don't go over each other; set the segments to three this time (Image 7). We need to remove unnecessary vertices from the even surfaces on top and bottom so we can bevel the edges evenly, so [k]A,X,L[/k] to perform a limited dissolve (Image 8). Select the top face and bevel it with three segments (Image 9). Select the edges around the top and bottom and [k]RMB > Mark Sharp[/k] (Image 10) so that if we turn on [k]Shade Auto Smooth[/k] those lines will be sharp. In the Outliner rename the mesh to 'ground' and organize the project (Image 11).

Add a cube to the scene, [k]/[/k] to go into Local View and [k]G,Z,1[/k] to move it up (Image 12). Set the size: [k]S,X,0.65[/k], [k]S,Y,0.65[/k], [k]S,Z,0.75[/k] (Image 13). Scale in the top face to taper the shape slightly (Image 14). Select a random edge and [k]G,G[/k] to Edge Slide it down (Image 15). Add a Bevel Modifier with the Amount set to 0.15 and the Segments to 2 (Image 16). Doing it through a modifier will allow you to continue to make changes to the underlying geometry while still creating bevels. [k]Shift-D,Y[/k] and create five variations of the rock, all lined up in the y-axis (Image 17). [k]/[/k] to exit Local View and you will see the rocks buried in the island (Image 18). [k]RMB[/k] the rocks collection in the Outliner and [k]Select Objects[/k] to select all the rocks (Image 19). [k]G,X[/k] to move them out in the x-axis to clear them from the island (Image 20). With them all selected [k]Ctrl-A,S[/k] to apply the scale (Image 21), this will ensure the Bevel Modifier is applied evenly across all axes. Duplicate, rotate, scale, and place rocks all around the island (Image 22).
